lens: Interaction and responsive accessibility, visible evidence only. All seven pairs inspected. Scores exclude outer padding, interaction behavior, keyboard access, semantics, measured contrast and measured target sizes. No score drops.

findings: Before hierarchy and typography/numbers 8: account names have the same weight as subordinate warning labels. After fixes this with bold names, strengthening account identity alongside the bold weekly percentages.
Both layout 8: warning labels and their percentages sit far apart across each wide column. Bring each warning percentage closer to its label while preserving the primary percentage alignment.
Both content 8: Cloud Session Credits at 0% still says Low, the same severity wording used for 14%. Give the zero-credit state an explicit label such as None remaining.

Both controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8: individual disclosure is represented by a small bare chevron, while Expand All has a visible button boundary. Give each account disclosure a clearer visible control area with more vertical breathing room; actual hit areas are not established by these images.
Before hierarchy and typography/numbers 8: regular-weight account names compete with warning text. After fixes this through bold account names without visible wrapping or clipping.
Both content 8: the 0% Cloud Session Credits warning says only Low. Replace that zero-value wording with None remaining.

Both controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8: bare disclosure chevrons occupy visually shallow account headers. Add a clearer disclosure control boundary and slightly more vertical spacing while retaining the three-column layout.
Before hierarchy and typography/numbers 8: account names and warning labels have similar emphasis. After fixes this with bold account names; weekly percentages remain aligned and readable.
Both content 8: Cloud Session Credits at 0% is labeled Low. Use explicit zero-remaining wording.

Both controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8: Expand All is visibly substantial, but per-account chevrons remain small and their header bands shallow. Give individual disclosures a similarly clear visible control area, especially the third account with no warning row.
Both layouts stack all three accounts and wrap the section metadata without visible clipping. No responsive layout regression is visible.

Both hierarchy and typography/numbers 8: the first account name occupies three lines beside a single-line percentage. Bold text improves identity in the after image but the long name still dominates the list. Show a concise account alias in the header and retain the full credential label in expanded details.

Both content 8: 2 loaded and 3 eligible require interpretation alongside Weekly quota unavailable, and the 0% warning says only Low. Clarify the count as 2 quotas available and use explicit zero-remaining wording.

Both controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8: the long account has a small chevron beside a multiline label, while the short third account has a shallow disclosure header. Give disclosures a consistent visible control area and minimum visual header height.
The after label reflows into different three-line breaks without visible clipping; the percentage stays separate. No score drop is warranted.
Before hierarchy and typography/numbers 8: account names are insufficiently distinguished from secondary labels. After fixes this with bold names, including the account whose quota is unavailable.
Both content 8: 2 loaded appears above three visible accounts, leaving the meaning of loaded indirect. Change it to 2 quotas available; label the separate 0% credit warning None remaining.
Both controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8: account disclosure remains a small bare chevron in a shallow header. Add a clearer visible disclosure control area with more vertical spacing.
The dash plus Weekly quota unavailable explains the missing value in text. That state remains legible in both versions.

Before hierarchy and typography/numbers 8: account identities have no weight distinction from subordinate text. After fixes this with bold names while retaining the visible Stale qualifier beside 82.8%.

Both content 8: 2 loaded does not directly explain that the third displayed percentage is historical. Use wording such as 2 current, 1 stale; replace Low on the separate 0% warning with None remaining.

Both controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8: disclosure chevrons remain visually small and unbounded. Give each account header a clearer visible disclosure control area and more vertical breathing room.
Stale and Last observed provide textual freshness cues in both images; the state does not depend on amber alone.
Before hierarchy and typography/numbers 8: account names have the same weight as quota labels. After fixes this through bold names while keeping Pro and points secondary.
Before consistency 8: lower metadata labels begin to the left of the quota-label alignment. After fixes this by aligning Last observed and Predicted empty with the account detail text.

Both layout 8: the shared footer baseline leaves a substantial blank band below the shorter second and third quota lists. Reduce the quota-to-footer gap or make the quota rows correspond across accounts so that reserved space aids comparison.
Both colour 8: the empty Cloud Session Credits bar is a faint dark track against the dark panel. Strengthen its visible outline while retaining the explicit 0% value.
Both content 8: Weekly Reset duplicates the 7-Day Limit reset timestamp, and 0% credits still says Low. Consolidate the repeated reset information and use explicit zero-remaining wording.

Both controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8: Collapse All has a visible button boundary, but individual collapse controls remain small bare chevrons in shallow headers. Give each disclosure a clearer visible control area with more vertical breathing room.
Only the wide expanded state is supplied here; expanded behavior at narrow widths is not established.
